# Leveraging satellite data to transform insurance claims

By Marla Glimtun, Senior Data Strategist, TerraScan Analytics

Last spring, after a series of unprecedented storms battered the Gulf Coast, a major insurer faced a daunting surge of claims. Traditionally, assessing roof damage across thousands of homes required dispatching adjusters—a slow, costly process delaying payouts and frustrating policyholders.

Satellite imagery analytics transformed this scenario. Using TerraScan’s RoofGuard algorithm, which evaluates roof conditions from high-resolution images updated weekly, the insurer swiftly identified severely damaged homes. This enabled prioritization for in-person inspections and even remote damage validations for minor cases. Concurrently, flood extent mapping from near-real-time satellite data helped allocate response resources efficiently across affected regions.

The results were striking: claim processing times dropped by 35%, while customer satisfaction scores climbed 20 points. Insurers should invest in integrating satellite-derived condition scoring into their claims workflows. Doing so not only accelerates catastrophe response but also reduces operational costs and improves transparency—benefits that are crucial as climate change intensifies weather-related risks. Satellite analytics is no longer a futuristic concept; it’s a strategic imperative for modern insurance.
